_approach: Modern riddim-style dubstep, a deliberate break from the halfstep 'never on 2 and 4' rule: per EDMProd's riddim breakdown, the classic 1-and-3 two-step kick gets a kick added on 2 and 4 as well, producing a stiff, robotic, almost four-to-the-floor stomp with near-zero swing and hypnotic repetition — the modern lineage of Ternion Sound/Subtronics-style riddim rather than DMZ meditation. Ref: EDMProd 'How to Make Riddim like Subtronics in 5 Easy Steps'.
